protocol_freeze.relevance: All required atoms yes; compatible family variants yes; partial=grade1 and binary negative; unknown=-1 excluded with coverage and precision bounds.
protocol_freeze.review: 200 root image/source reviews, expanded deterministically into 4000 query-image judgments; not 4000 independent expert annotations.
protocol_freeze.freeze_stage: Initial image/source review before new model rankings. v5.1 protocol correction after rankings: broad dates/materials do not establish negative fine labels; empty visual conjunction unknown. No image review retuned to model outputs.

limitations: Reused historical test images, AI image/source relevance rather than human expert gold.
Unknowns are excluded with coverage and pessimistic/optimistic precision bounds.
Set recall applies to 140-image exhaustively judged core, not to the other full-gallery images.
Supervised boundary uses same intents with disjoint development images; not unseen-query generalization.
